title: hotfix: SLO enforcer threshold smoothing + regional failover backoff to prevent thrashing
author: Aisha Patel
checks_summary: ci/integration: failed (regional_failover_simulation) on first run due to timing window; retried
description: Context: a production incident on 2026-02-18 revealed the SLO enforcer could enter a thrashing state during multi-region capacity pressure. When one region reported transient high latency, the enforcer aggressively opened circuit breakers and initiated failover, which in turn created capacity pressure in secondary regions and triggered oscillating back-and-forth failovers and load-shedding. This PR implements a targeted hotfix that smooths threshold transitions, adds backoff/hysteresis for regional failover decisions, and tightens load-shedding guards to prevent cascading thrash. Motivation: reduce user-visible 5xx/latency spikes and eliminate failover loops that cause overall system instability. What changed (summary): - Add threshold smoothing window to SLO enforcer (exponential moving average on short windows) so single-window spikes don't immediately flip state. - Introduce regional-failover backoff: once a region is failed over, subsequent automated failovers for the same customer/route are suppressed for a configurable window and escalate only after sustained degradation. - Add guard to load-shedding: require two consecutive evaluation windows or a minimum failure delta before shedding heavy clients. - Update metrics emitted (slo_enforcer.evaluation_window, regional_failover.backoff_state, load_shed.decision_count) and add tracing spans for decision boundaries to aid post-mortem. - Add unit and integration tests that simulate multi-region oscillation and verify no repeated failover within backoff window. - Docs: ops playbook updated with emergency remediation steps and tuning knobs. Risk: low; behaviour change is scoped to automatic failover/backoff logic and guarded by a feature-flag (defaults to enabled for SRE rollout). Rollout plan: merge to main, staged Canary rollout to 10% of customers in us-west-2/us-east-1 for 1 hour with retention monitoring; full rollout if no regressions. Related: ENG-2145 (improve SLO enforcer stability), SUP-5678 (customer-reported failover thrash incident).

release_notes: Hotfix: Prevent SLO enforcer regional failover thrashing by adding threshold smoothing, per-route backoff, and conservative load-shedding guards. Improves stability during transient region pressure. Configurable via slo.enforcer.smoothing.window_ms and slo.enforcer.backoff.window_ms.
